objective.text: Set a custom outer data wrapper without changing the model's stored attributes.

difficulty.rationale: Rename the outer representation without changing persisted data.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: An unpaginated API resource should use item instead of data as its outer wrapper. Its underlying model must stay unchanged. Which configuration targets that wrapper?

options.text: Set public static $wrap = "item" on the resource class.
options.rationale: The resource wrapper property controls the outer envelope and does not rename model attributes.

options.text: Rename the model’s primary key column to item.
options.rationale: A database identifier name does not configure the resource envelope.
options.misconception: A database identifier name does not configure the resource envelope.

options.text: Return ["item" => $this->id] as the entire toArray result.
options.rationale: That changes entity fields and still sits inside the normal outer wrapper.
options.misconception: That changes entity fields and still sits inside the normal outer wrapper.

options.text: Add item to the model’s $appends list.
options.rationale: Appended attributes belong to model data, not the outer resource envelope.
options.misconception: Appended attributes belong to model data, not the outer resource envelope.
